speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Helix crews are hitting the towers, trying to crack them before you reach the crater.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: I rigged a Shard relay out of Nana Wren's old ship radio. Now your Shards can talk to every tower, and Static can call every Keeper!

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Ferrox first. Then Static's tower on Neonis. Kit, you're with the Linker.

speaker: DJ Static
text: This is Static, live on every frequency in the Kessler system. You need to hear this.

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: [log] Reyes was an acceptable loss.

speaker: DJ Static
text: And this: Project Unity. Helix has been caging one of every Alienmon to force the Seedmother's power. Look at these cages, people.

speaker: Narrator
text: On every world, people stop and listen. By morning, nobody believes Helix anymore.

speaker: DJ Static
text: The Keepers are with you, Linker. When you need us, just call. We'll sing.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: The towers won't hold themselves!

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Every Keeper's on the line now. Whatever happens at that crater, you won't be alone.

speaker: Old Dusty
text: Haven't seen a Cactling bloom in years. Catch one and show me?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Old Dusty
text: Look at those petals! Here, a little something for your trouble.

speaker: DX-4
text: Bzzt. Three of my bolts rolled away in the Starfall wind. Retrieve them?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: DX-4
text: Systems at 100%! Accept this Stun Spray, Linker.

speaker: Narrator
text: The pink Alienmon puffs up its gills. It looks like it wants a rematch... again and again.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: After its third loss it happily hands you a shiny stone it was guarding.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Name's Tamsin. Explorer. (She tips a battered straw hat. Her vest is covered in patches from a hundred places.)

speaker: Tamsin
text: This one? (She taps a patch shaped like a question mark.) That's the world I never found.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Now, your field test. First rule: a capture isn't taking. It's asking.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Weaken it gently with a Tether Pulse, calm it with a Stun Spray, then ask with your beam.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Textbook! See? It said yes.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Keep these. And if you ever find a world nobody has mapped, come and tell me about it.

speaker: Forge Miner Dax
text: Beat every trainer on the Frontier and you'll earn a Frontier Badge of honor.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Forge Miner Dax
text: All five! Here, a Singularity Cell. Don't waste it.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: Wild Alienmon keep chewing my relay cables. Thin them out a little?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: Signal's clean again. Thanks! Take some Tether Pulses.

speaker: Explorer (townsfolk)
text: The hut needs fresh herbs. A Bio-type Alienmon could grow them. Catch one?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Explorer (townsfolk)
text: Perfect! The hut will stay stocked for weeks. Here's a Revive Spark.

speaker: Miner (townsfolk)
text: Dropped my lucky pick near the Shadow Tunnel. Too spooky to go back alone.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Miner (townsfolk)
text: My lucky pick! You're a lifesaver.

speaker: Squid Sailor
text: The ferry crew's been working double shifts. A Mega Gel for them would go a long way.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Squid Sailor
text: Crew says thanks! You ride free, forever.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ystran echo: ...the mountain's heart remembers Ystra... go deeper...

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: Deep in the Magma Mines a crystal hums with the echo's voice. You take the Ystra Shardlet.

speaker: Grub
text: Bring me five scrap cogs from the lava trails and I'll trade you something special.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Grub
text: Heh, pleasure doing business. One Singularity Cell, as promised.

speaker: Grub
text: A Gleamgrub eats rust and spits out polish. I need one for my shop!

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Grub
text: Shiny! Here's your cut.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Three junkers keep jamming my cranes. Teach 'em some manners.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Cranes are running smooth. You're welcome back anytime.

speaker: Scrapper (townsfolk)
text: A Forgemaul's been hammering in the furnace ridge at night. Nobody's caught one.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Scrapper (townsfolk)
text: You actually did it! Legend.

speaker: Dr. Lysa Moor
text: I need two glowing specimens: a Lumislug and a Puffspore.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Dr. Lysa Moor
text: Their glow matches the Starfall pods exactly. Fascinating!

speaker: Narrator
text: Sporefolk elder: Our little one wandered into the mist. Follow the glowing mushrooms!

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: The little sporeling clings to you all the way home. The elder gives you a woven charm.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib beeps excitedly. Another saucer signal pings from the bog.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: Two Zibs! They blink at each other in perfect sync.

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: Helix scattered my logbook to the wind. Three pages are still out there.

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: And there's a Helix freighter drifting off the docks with nobody aboard. The crews call it the ghost ship. Something in its hold howls at night.

speaker: Narrator
text: You climb down into the ghost ship's hold. Rows of empty cages rattle in the swell.

speaker: Narrator
text: The howl comes from the very last cage. It isn't a ghost at all. It's a lost little Chirpod, calling and calling for anyone to answer.

speaker: Narrator
text: You open the cage. The Chirpod hops onto your arm and won't let go.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: The last page... it shows where they took the core: the Helix Forge Fortress.

speaker: Kid (townsfolk)
text: I want a Bubbub for the tide pool! Pleeease?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Kid (townsfolk)
text: It blew a bubble on my nose! Best day ever!

speaker: Squid Sailor
text: Old sailors say an anchor-beast sleeps under the sea arch.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Squid Sailor
text: By the tides... you caught the legend!

speaker: DJ Static
text: My backup dancers want a battle-off. Three rounds. You in?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: DJ Static
text: The crowd LOVES you! Here's a VIP pass and some cash.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: Glitchbugs keep crashing the starport. Collect three and I'll rehome them.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: Systems stable. Thanks, Linker!

speaker: Dr. Imogen Vashti
text: Retune three city antennas to the crater pulse and we'll triangulate the source.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Dr. Imogen Vashti
text: Triangulated. The pulse comes from INSIDE the crater, from somewhere else entirely.

speaker: Researcher (townsfolk)
text: Make rubbings of five carved stones. They may be a map.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Researcher (townsfolk)
text: It IS a map, of the Relay Towers!

speaker: Pilgrim (townsfolk)
text: The bell court's song fell silent. A Chimelet could bring it back.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: The bells ring again. The pilgrim weeps with joy.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ystran echo: ...the great doors sleep... guardians of stone keep the halls...

speaker: Narrator
text: Ystran echo: ...turn the light toward the doors... and only a Chimelet's note can wake them...

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Chimelet sings one clear note. The great doors shiver, then swing slowly open.

speaker: Narrator
text: Behind them, the oldest mural of all: tiny crystal people waving goodbye to a sky full of seedpods.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ystran echo: ...you listened... thank you...

speaker: Old Basalt
text: My old lantern's down the deep shaft. Fetch it? These knees won't.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Still burning after forty years. Thank you, youngster.

speaker: Miner (townsfolk)
text: Kindleflies light the tunnels for us. Catch two for the night shift?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Miner (townsfolk)
text: The tunnels are glowing again. Great work!

speaker: Forge Miner Dax
text: The deep crew thinks they're the toughest Linkers on Pyros. Prove 'em wrong.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Forge Miner Dax
text: Ha! They'll be talking about this for years.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: The aurora is acting strangely. Check it from three lookouts.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: It pulses with the crater signal. The whole system is listening.

speaker: Researcher (townsfolk)
text: My Alienmon fainted in the cold. Do you have a Revive Spark?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Researcher (townsfolk)
text: You saved us both. Take my field notes and these supplies.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: A Glaciryx nests behind the frozen waterfall. Only the bravest try.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: Incredible. You have the coldest nerve I've ever seen.

speaker: Admin Bronn
text: This whole wing is Project Unity: one of every species Helix has found, catalogued like museum pieces.

speaker: Admin Bronn
text: Open the cages and Thorne's collection is broken.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: The freed Alienmon chirp their thanks. Several follow your transfer beam to your ship's storage.

speaker: Narrator
text: Kit refuses to leave until every cage is open. Kit's {kit3} digs in and roots the last stuck doors wide open.

speaker: Kit Briggs
text: [shaking] Nobody gets left.

speaker: Narrator
text: Project Unity is broken. Helix's collection is gone.

speaker: Strand
text: The Nullbots guard Thorne's files. Beat three and the server unlocks.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Strand
text: Thorne's files... the Rift engine schematics. This proves everything.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: Light the four old lanterns. The Wailshades fear warm light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: Gravewell glows amber again. The children come out to play.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: My old notes are in the ruined lab. They prove Thorne knew the Devourer was real.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: Now everyone will know the truth about Helix.

speaker: Kid (townsfolk)
text: Can I see a Psi-type up close? Pleeeease!

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Kid (townsfolk)
text: Its eyes glow! I'm gonna be a Linker someday, just like you!

speaker: Wanderer (townsfolk)
text: I chased a Novaling all the way up here. If you ever catch one, show me?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Wanderer (townsfolk)
text: A real Novaling! It's like holding a star.

speaker: Echo & Iris
text: Two reflections live in the clouds: Mirrix and Reflix. Catch both.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Echo & Iris
text: We saw you'd do it. But it's still nice to watch.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: Each shell holds a memory of Ystra. Help me gather five.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: Lumivex can hear them singing. Thank you.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: Dad left his journal at his old camp. Can we find it together?

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: "Day one: the light is beautiful." ...Thanks for coming with me.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: Align the three nodes and we can see the Warp Gate from here.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: Through the lens, the far Warp Gate flickers... like it's breathing.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: The Quorum wants a rematch, stronger than before. Weekly.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: Still the Prime Linker. Impressive.

speaker: Dr. Imogen Vashti
text: Register 150 Alienmon in your Xenodex and I'll give you my rarest cell.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Dr. Imogen Vashti
text: Half the system catalogued! You've earned this.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ystran echo: ...gather our voices... so the Seedmother can hear...

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: The echoes merge into one clear song. Their song drifts across the bare land toward the Heartroot's crater.

speaker: Liss
text: The little shadows in this forest are pieces of Oblivane's hunger. They are not attacking you. They are begging.

speaker: Liss
text: Meet them gently. Kit's {kit3} can heal a little of the blight, tree by tree.

speaker: Narrator
text: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.

speaker: Narrator
text: The little shadow creatures settle, one by one, like birds coming home to roost.

speaker: Narrator
text: A few crystal leaves bloom... but nothing will truly grow until the Heartroot does.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: A Helix shuttle just crashed in the Arcade District! Its cargo hold burst open, and now there are Glitchbugs everywhere.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: They're scrambling every screen in the city. Can you round them up before the whole grid goes dark?

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: Still more out there! Listen for the buzzing.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: That's the last of them! The grid is back up.

speaker: Technician (townsfolk)
text: Huh. That last little one won't leave your side. I think it's picked you.

speaker: Mina
text: This hood? It's a shark. Obviously. And I need your help.

speaker: Mina
text: Splodge, my Bubbub, chased a wave all the way out past the point and didn't come back. He always ends up at Coral Cove.

speaker: Mina
text: Bring him home? And show me you can look after a water Alienmon of your own. Then we'll talk about rides.

beat: scene: Find Splodge at Coral Cove
speaker: Narrator
text: Something giggles out in the shallows. A huge shiny bubble bobs over the waves, bouncing off the rocks like a beach ball.

beat: scene: Find Splodge at Coral Cove
speaker: Narrator
text: Inside it sits a little round Bubbub with two flippers and a big happy grin. Splodge!

beat: scene: Find Splodge at Coral Cove
speaker: Narrator
text: Splodge gurgles, rolls straight up the beach and bumps into your legs. He has decided to follow you home.

speaker: Mina
text: Splodge loves Coral Cove. Look for a giggling bubble in the shallows!

speaker: Mina
text: SPLODGE! You silly bubble. Thank you, Linker!

speaker: Mina
text: You know what? He likes you. Keep him. Walk out onto deep water and Splodge will carry you anywhere.

speaker: Mina
text: Just don't pop him.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Think you can dent my armor, kid? Let's see.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Ha! You've got grit. Take the shard.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Keep that Linker oiled.

speaker: Dr. Lysa Moor
text: Let me show you how patient poison can be.

speaker: Dr. Lysa Moor
text: Fascinating. You adapted quickly.

speaker: Dr. Lysa Moor
text: The spores glow brighter when you're near. Curious.

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: The tide waits for no one. Battle stations!

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: You sailed through that storm. Well done.

speaker: Captain Delia Marsh
text: Watch out for Helix. They're after the tower cores.

speaker: DJ Static
text: Turn it up! This battle's going live!

speaker: DJ Static
text: That's a wrap. You rocked the stage.

speaker: DJ Static
text: That signal from the Rift? It sounds like a lullaby.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Sixty years in the mines. Show me your fire.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Hmph. The fire in you burns true.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Find Teo's girl. She deserves to know.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: Let's see if you can keep your cool.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: You thawed my best defense. Impressive.

speaker: Ingrid Vale
text: Whatever made those bite marks is still out there.

speaker: Admin Vex
text: A kid with a Linker? Thorne will love this.

speaker: Admin Vex
text: Tch. Thorne won't care. He's already at the Rift.

speaker: Admin Vex
text: Go ahead, chase him. You'll never stop it.

speaker: Echo & Iris
text: We already saw this battle. Shall we see how it ends?

speaker: Echo & Iris
text: The vision changed. Because of you.

speaker: Echo & Iris
text: The Rift. The shadow. A girl and her father. We saw it all.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: The Devourer follows the light. Prove you can stand in the dark.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: You're ready. Take the last shard.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: With 8 shards, the Rift will let you land. Stop Thorne.

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: The Rift is mine. Unlimited Alienmon. Unlimited power. Move aside!

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: No... the shadow... it's coming through!

speaker: Director Kael Thorne
text: The Rift is sealed. Teo Reyes is home. ...I was wrong.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: I bonded the very first Alienmon. Show me what you've built.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: You're the Prime Linker now. Vashti and I always suspected the truth. The towers were a seal.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: Ystra's fragments drift in the old Rift. Go see where they came from.
